sourceProfile.scope: PSPUpsample only; PSP pooling, enclosing decoder and classifier excluded
sourceProfile.shape_origin: explicit static module profile; not observed

sourceFacts: Bilinear F.upsample doubles input H and W before the convolution, rather than applying pixel channel rearrangement.
Conv3 padding1 retains enlarged16x16 and has default biasTrue; BN32 follows it.
nn.PReLU() owns exactly one learned slope initialized0.25, shared across all32 channels; it is not a fixed ReLU.
align_corners is omitted in this historical API call; drawing does not invent a default or execute the library.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
